instruction.text: Mark is walking around his village. If he followed the directions given, where would he end up? Select the correct location on the map.

atoms.a:
1. Start at the park.
2. Walk forward in a straight line.
3. Do not make any turns.

1. Start at the phone box.
2. Walk forward in a straight line and stop after the first crossroads.
3. Make a quarter turn to the left.

1. Start next to the library.
2. Walk forward in a straight line and stop before the first junction.
3. Make a quarter turn in an anticlockwise direction.

1. Start between the school and the supermarket.
2. Walk forward in a straight line in the direction of the pond.
3. Make a quarter turn to the right at the junction.
4. Walk forward in a straight line and stop before the crossroads.
5. Make a quarter turn in an anticlockwise direction.

1. Start next to the bus stop.
2. Walk forward in a straight line and stop at the first crossroads.
3. Make a quarter turn in a clockwise direction.
4. Walk forward in a straight line until the end of the road.

1. Start next to the supermarket.
2. Walk forward in a straight line and stop at the crossroads.
3. Make a quarter turn in an anticlockwise direction.
4. Walk forward in a straight line and stop between the school and the pond.
5. Make a quarter turn in a clockwise direction.
